title: distributed-invoice-sample-validator
creator: Maya Patel
description: Purpose: build a distributed validator service that samples invoice-bound token attributions from the real-time metering stream and verifies convergence against the canonical billing ledger before invoices are generated. Motivation: we've seen intermittent divergences between nearline meter samples (used for dashboards and prebilling alerts) and the authoritative ledger after late-arriving events and shard rebalances. This ticket implements a lightweight, production-safe probing layer that (1) selects representative samples across routes/tenants, (2) performs deterministic aggregation using the same logic as the ledger job, and (3) surfaces deltas with confidence scoring to operators and automatic remediation hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Validator service samples >= 0.5% of invoice-bound sessions across top 100 tenants and provides daily convergence reports
End-to-end idempotent aggregation: validator must reproduce ledger totals for sample windows within 0.2% for non-late tokens and explain >90% of deviations via late-arrival metadata
Validator writes anomaly records to billing-alerts topic with schema v2 and includes shard provenance and reconciliation_trace_id
No more than 1% increase in downstream write latency on the ledger compactor cluster when validator is enabled in shadow mode
Feature-flagged rollout with canary on 5% tenants and automated rollback based on false-positive rate > 5% or P999 latency breaches
Unit/integration tests cover protobuf schema compatibility, idempotency on duplicate samples, and simulated shard failover scenarios
Operational dashboard with daily coverage, false-positive rate, top-10 divergence reasons, and a drilldown to raw sample traces is available in Console
Runbook updated with remediation steps and links to PRs/Playbooks; Pager escalation only for confirmed divergence impacting invoice totals > $1000
notes: Design choice: implement validator as a Flink streaming job co-located in the metric ingestion layer to reuse existing checkpointing and exactly-once sink semantics
We'll reuse the canonical aggregation SQL functions from the ledger to avoid logic drift; code will import the ledger aggregation library as a compiled artifact
Sampling strategy: stratified sampling by tenant size and route type, with heavier weights on high-commitment customers and multi-model routes
To minimize operational risk initial rollout will be shadow-mode writes only (no direct ledger writes) and write to a separate topic consumed by ops and a reconciliation worker
Data retention: samples stored 30 days with a compacted key of tenant|window|route for manual audits
Privacy: scrub PII by hashing session identifiers; security review required because validator reads raw session envelopes
Performance target: validator job must process peak ingestion with <10% CPU overhead on a reserved slot and respect existing autoscaling policies
implementation_plan: Week 1: schema design and proto v2 for anomaly records; wire up sampling knobs and unit tests
Week 2: prototype Flink job that replays sampled events and applies ledger aggregation functions; local tooling for deterministic replay
Week 3: integrate idempotent sink to anomaly topic, add provenance fields, and build initial dashboard queries in Console
Week 4: shadow rollout to canary tenants (5%), collect metrics for two billing cycles, iterate on sampling weights
Week 5: expand to 25% tenants if false-positive rate < 3% and no latency regressions; prepare runbook and engage finance for signoff
Follow-up: enable automated remediation hooks (recompute job trigger or compensating ledger patch) behind a manual approval gate
risks: Sampling bias may miss rare reconciliation edge cases; mitigated by periodic targeted audits using full-history replays
Increased load on ingestion path during initial rollout; mitigation via strict feature flag and cpu quotas per slot
Logic drift if ledger aggregation evolves; mitigation by importing compiled ledger aggregation artifact and adding CI compatibility tests
False positives create operational noise; mitigation by confidence scoring and thresholded alerting, require manual confirmation for invoice-impacting divergences
observability_goals: Expose per-tenant reconciliation score and delta histogram to Console
Alert when daily sample coverage < 0.3% for any top-100 tenant
Traceability: include reconciliation_trace_id linking sample -> validator job -> ledger snapshot -> anomaly record
Latency SLO: 99.9th percentile validator processing latency < 15s for sample windows
qa_and_test_plan: Fuzz tests that inject out-of-order and late-arriving tokens across shards to assert reconciliation explanations
End-to-end nightly job that replays full 24-hour window in test cluster and compares validator output with canonical ledger
Chaos test: simulate operator-induced shard rebalance and ensure idempotent sample aggregation
Load test at 3x peak sampling rate to verify autoscaling and CPU overhead assumptions
